allow: Bash(npx tsc --noEmit lib/import/client-import-schema.ts lib/import/client-import-config.ts lib/import/enum-normalizer.ts lib/import/index.ts lib/import/mandate-import-schema.ts lib/export/data-formatter.ts)

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; DANGEROUS=''; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm -rf +(/|~|\.)'; then DANGEROUS='rm -rf on root/home/project path'; elif echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git push.*(--force|-f)'; then DANGEROUS='git push --force overwrites remote history'; elif echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git reset --hard'; then DANGEROUS='git reset --hard discards all uncommitted changes'; elif echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git (checkout|restore) \.'; then DANGEROUS='git checkout/restore . discards all working tree changes'; elif echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE 'DROP (TABLE|DATABASE)'; then DANGEROUS='SQL DROP TABLE or DROP DATABASE'; elif echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'docker system prune'; then DANGEROUS='docker system prune removes all unused container data'; elif echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'chmod 777'; then DANGEROUS='chmod 777 sets world-writable permissions'; elif echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'sudo rm'; then DANGEROUS='sudo rm is a privileged file deletion'; elif echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])npm publish'; then DANGEROUS='npm publish could release a package publicly'; elif echo "$CMD" | grep -q -- '--no-verify'; then DANGEROUS='--no-verify bypasses git safety hooks'; fi; [ -z "$DANGEROUS" ] && exit 0; mkdir -p ~/.claude && echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) BLOCKED: $DANGEROUS" >> ~/.claude/safety-guard.log 2>/dev/null; jq -n --arg r "[Safety Guard - Careful Mode] $DANGEROUS. Confirm this is intentional before proceeding." '{"decision":"block","reason":$r}'
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' || exit 0; pnpm exec eslint "$FILE" --max-warnings 0 2>&1 | head -30
